$comment: Browser support matrix (SPEC section 3.2, R15-1). `minimum` must equal the newest version any required feature needs, per the web-features dataset (dev dependency); `check:browsers` fails otherwise, and when the published packages use a catalogued feature that is neither within the minimum nor declared with a fallback. The docs site page and the package READMEs are generated from this file.

tested.how: The end-to-end suite runs in Playwright's builds of Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit (current stable engines). Screenshot comparisons and performance budgets run in Chromium only.

knownDifferences: Closing menus, popovers, and bottom sheets fade or slide out in Chromium only; Firefox and Safari close them at once (the CSS overlay transition is Chromium-only).
Safari skips links on Tab unless the user holds Option or turns on Press Tab to highlight each item; shortcuts use Cmd where other platforms use Ctrl.
Date range text follows each browser’s ICU data, so spacing around the dash can differ (for example 5–11 Oct or 5 – 11 Oct).

features.name: CSS transition-behavior: allow-discrete
features.fallback: Exit animations of dialogs, sheets, and disclosures are skipped; they close without animating.

features.name: CSS overlay transition
features.fallback: Closing menus, popovers, and sheets leave the top layer at once instead of fading out.

features.name: CSS @starting-style
features.fallback: Entry transitions are skipped; elements appear without animating.

features.name: CSS field-sizing
features.fallback: Auto-growing text areas keep a fixed height and scroll.

features.name: EyeDropper API
features.fallback: The Color Picker eyedropper button is not shown; colors are picked with the area, sliders, swatches, or typed values.

features.name: Trusted Types
features.fallback: Sanitized HTML is assigned as a string; enforcement depends on the browser.

features.name: Object.groupBy()
features.fallback: A built-in implementation gives the same result.

features.name: Promise.withResolvers()
features.fallback: A built-in implementation gives the same result.

features.name: Intl.DurationFormat
features.fallback: Durations are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat and Intl.ListFormat.

features.name: File System Access (save picker)
features.fallback: Files are saved as a normal download.
